conditions: Houston holds Brooklyn's pick outright (2021 Harden trade) and a right to swap with Miami (2021 Oladipo trade); HR_sep21: HOU receives the two most favorable of the BKN/MIA/HOU picks, MIA the least favorable.
Miami's pick is top-14 protected for the swap: if MIA's pick lands 1-14, MIA keeps its own pick and HOU keeps the BKN and HOU picks.
HR_mar22 frames it only as HOU getting the better of the BKN and MIA picks (MIA the worse); identical to the ranks above unless HOU's own pick is the least favorable of the three.

BKN.text: Houston holds BKN's pick and may swap with Miami (MIA top-14 protected): HOU ends up with the two best of BKN/HOU/MIA, MIA the worst. open_issues: PHI: Brooklyn held an unprotected 2022 PHI first with an option to defer it to 2023. The option is not expressible; coded 'to BKN' (low). Brooklyn deferred (reported 2022-06-01), so PHI selected at #23 itself -> realized holder PHI differs from rule holder BKN. Explained by the deferral, not a data error; the pick became PHI's 2023 first (see 2023 ledger pool BKN/HOU/PHI).

NOP: three-way split (NOP 1-4, POR 5-14, CHA 15-30) is not expressible. Coded protected keep 1-4 else CHA (low): exact for NOP's own incentive and for slots 15-30 (the realized #15 is consistent), wrong holder (should be POR) if the pick lands 5-14. At HR_mar22 NOP was 9th in the lottery standings and projected into the play-in, so both branches were live. Side consideration per HR_sep21: if the pick lands 1-4 or 15-30, NOP instead owes POR the MIL 2025 first (top-4 protected); if it lands 1-14, NOP instead sends CHA two second-rounders.

LAL: pick goes to NOP if 1-10, to MEM if 11-30; the Lakers never keep it. Coded 'to NOP' (low): exact for LAL's incentive, wrong holder (should be MEM) for slots 11-30. At HR_mar22 LAL was tied with NYK for the 10th-worst record, so both branches were live. Realized #8 -> NOP (consistent). HR_sep21 adds that NOP sends MEM two second-rounders if NOP gets the pick.

BKN/HOU/MIA pool: HR_sep21 (three-pick framing, MIA swap top-14 protected) vs HR_mar22 (two-pick framing: HOU gets better of BKN/MIA). Encoded the three-pick framing; the two coincide whenever HOU's own pick is not the least favorable of the three (it was #3 in reality). The MIA top-14 protection is stated only in HR_sep21 -> medium.
Consistency check: applying each native's rule to its realized slot reproduces the realized pre-draft holder for 29 of 30 natives; the single mismatch is PHI #23 (deferral, above).

Realized holders from NBA_2022 plus native slots derived from WIKI_2022 'from' annotations and 2021-22 records (UTA 49-33 -> #22, MEM 56-26 -> #29). Some Wikipedia 'from' annotations are ambiguous (e.g., 'from Utah' notes attached to #22/#29 and a chain to MIL #24); resolved using final records and HR_mar22 projections.

Draft-night trades (not mismatches; pre-draft holder recorded): #11 NYK->OKC, #13 CHA->NYK->DET, #19 MIN->MEM, #22 MEM->MIN (later UTA), #23 PHI->MEM, #26 DAL->HOU->MIN, #29 MEM->MIN->HOU, #30 OKC->DEN.
No 2022 first-round picks were forfeited; the 2022 forfeitures (MIL; MIA's, originally PHI's via DEN, per WIKI_2022) were second-rounders.
